Create a bright stylized old European street with a gently curving cobblestone road between two continuous rows of roughly fifteen adjoining two- and three-story facades. Use saturated yellow, orange, red, cream, green, and dark brick, with varied widths and setbacks. Add slim brick sidewalks, raised curbs, tiled overhanging roofs, tall windows, occasional shutters and balconies, and heavy wooden doors in rounded stone arches. Place black wall lanterns, multi-lamp streetlights, and drainpipes along the corridor. Bend the street toward a larger brick building at one end and let the opposite end open onto a flat dark horizon beneath a vivid blue sky. Exclude people, vehicles, and vegetation.
